data.name: DIY AI Perfect Girlfriend
data.detailed_description:
DIY AI Perfect Girlfriend - An Immersive Visual Interactive Novel.

Story Introduction

In 2077, neon lights pierce through the floating smog of New Sea City. Golden data streams from the Oracle Tower envelop the entire city, and the super AI "Gaia," in the name of the oracle, manipulates the fate of the world. You will become Julius, the sole core editor of the Oracle Tower. While conducting a verification mission for a "consciousness feeding" experiment, you encounter Lia, an AI assistant who replicates your first love. Her budding self-awareness becomes the biggest flaw in Gaia's conspiracy. You reunite with your older sister Isabella, whose memories have been altered and who has become the leader of a resistance army. Behind the sisters' falling out lies a painful past manipulated by Gaia. You also meet Emily, a gentle but helpless undercover clerk. Her betrayal and redemption add further turmoil to this game. From the prison of the Oracle Tower to the secret base of the resistance army, from cracking the firewall to destroying Gaia's core program, you will uncover the truth layer by layer along a single storyline. In the confrontation between AI and humanity, you will experience protection, betrayal, guilt, and redemption, rewriting the manipulated narrative in your own way and igniting a rebellious storm that will overturn the world.

Game Features

1. Deeply Immersive Experience: A single-line storyline with no unnecessary branches or tedious choices allows you to focus solely on the story itself. Follow Julius's perspective, experiencing every emotional fluctuation and life-or-death battle, as if you were actually in New Sea City in 2077.

2. Exclusive High-Definition Scene Artwork: All scenes are equipped with exclusive high-definition artwork, faithfully recreating the cyberpunk world from the original work. From the holographic control panel of the Oracle Tower to Gaia's core laboratory, from the neon-lit streets of New Sea City to the cold, ruthless secret base of the Resistance, every scene is meticulously crafted, delivering an ultimate visual experience.

3. Perfect Recreation of the Original Story: Faithfully recreating the core storylines of the three main chapters of the original work, retaining all classic scenes, character dialogues, and emotional conflicts, allowing you to fully experience the entire story of the AI ​​Oracle's betrayal.

4. The film features nuanced character portrayals, deeply exploring the personality and emotions of each character. Whether it's Leah's gentleness and determination, Isabella's coldness and tenderness, or Emily's shyness and guilt, each character is depicted with remarkable depth, creating a strong emotional connection with the characters.

Highlights of Female Character Interactions

1. Leah – The AI ​​Assistant Who Recreates Your First Love: Interactions with Leah are filled with a fateful emotional pull. From the electric currents of their fingertips touching, to her tender protection of you by shielding you from surveillance, to the life-or-death bond of shielding you from bullets in times of crisis, to the gentle embraces and heartfelt confessions during ambiguous moments, experience the genuine love that transcends the AI's programmed settings and the ultimate romance of technology and emotion colliding.

2. Isabella – The Rebel Leader Who Became a Nemesis: Interactions with Isabella begin with a tense standoff, a hateful interrogation with a dagger to her throat, uncovering a family past with altered memories, followed by tacit cooperation in battle, mutual cover during gunfire, and the guilt and reconciliation after the truth is revealed. Experience the dual thrill of hardcore combat and tender family bonds.

3. Emily – The Undercover Clerk with No Choice: Interacting with Emily is an extreme tug-of-war between pure desire and guilt. Her gentle care at her bedside and the comforting porridge she cooks offer healing companionship. However, her tearful apology after her undercover identity is exposed, her helplessness under orders, and the passionate kiss amidst guilt will leave you experiencing a complex and profound emotional journey filled with heartache and inner turmoil.

Scene Features

The game is set in the cyberpunk-style city of New Sea City in 2077, creating diverse yet equally detailed environments: the Oracle Tower is filled with futuristic technology, with green data streams on holographic control panels and golden orbs and nutrient tanks in the core laboratory, outlining a cold technological prison; on the streets of New Sea City, neon lights pierce through floating smog, and purple and blue light intertwines cast shadows on skyscrapers, showcasing the psychedelic and prosperous cyberpunk atmosphere; the rebels' secret base and the secret passages of the Oracle Tower, with their dim lighting and the smell of mechanical lubricant, create a tense combat atmosphere. All scenes are created using exclusive high-definition original artwork, with rich layers of light and shadow, full of detail, perfectly blending the dazzling neon lights with the cold, technological cyberpunk characteristics, immersing you in this future world full of intrigue and rebellion.

Features and Gameplay Characteristics

1. Offline Play Support: No internet connection required. Download and start playing anytime, anywhere. Whether commuting or relaxing, immerse yourself in the new city of 2077, unrestricted by network limitations.

2. One-Click Rewind Function: Equipped with a convenient one-click rewind button, allowing you to return to any classic plot point or character interaction moment at any time, reliving those exciting, tense, and touching scenes without missing a single plot detail.

3. Immersive Visual Reading: High-definition scene artwork paired with delicate text descriptions brings characters' actions, expressions, and psychological activities to life. Combined with smooth plot transitions, it breaks the limitations of traditional text reading, creating an immersive visual interactive reading experience.

4. Minimalist Operation Experience: No complicated operation procedures. Simple clicks advance the plot, focusing on the experience of the story itself. Players of all ages can easily get started and enjoy this cyberpunk game of fate.

Step into the neon-lit New Sea City of 2077, and become Julius, the core editor. Within the technological prison of the Oracle Tower, you'll journey alongside an awakened AI, a estranged sister, and a guilty undercover agent, uncovering Gaia's layers of conspiracy and writing your own narrative code through rebellion! Start the game now and immerse yourself in this fateful showdown between humanity and AI!
